trap.label: want that
trap.wrong: My teacher wants that I read more.
trap.right: My teacher wants me to read more.
trap.why: Em português 'quer que eu leia' usa subordinada com que; em inglês, want + pessoa + to + verbo.

mcq.q: Pronome certo: She wants ___ to call.

fix.right: I want you to come early.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Dad wants. I wash the car.”
rewrite.answer: Dad wants me to wash the car.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Ms. Lee wants. They submit it.”
rewrite.answer: Ms. Lee wants them to submit it.
